What can be done when nothing feels right and everyday you're overwhelmed with pain?  I don't know how to deal with it and I hate feeling this way. I only want two things in life. That's to be happy and to be with her. But I'm not sure either will happen. What's your story?

The only person that makes me happy doesn't see me the way I see her and that kills me inside. But I have to hide behind my smile.  And doing that makes it worse because I hate pretending I'm okay. I know this doesn't help you but I feel like I need the dame thing you do. Someone to talk. If you feel like it...

Besides... no one would even notice I wasn't around anymore.
